members.name: children
members.doc: Nested rows. Leave undefined and set hasChildren to load them on first expand with loadChildren.

members.name: hasChildren
members.doc: Marks a row whose children are not loaded yet.

members.name: sortValue
members.doc: Makes the column sortable. Siblings are sorted within their parent, so the hierarchy never breaks.

members.name: width
members.doc: A grid track, such as "120px" or "minmax(0, 2fr)". Defaults to "minmax(0, 1fr)".

members.name: hideBelow
members.doc: Hides the column while the table is narrower than this many px.

types.name: TreeTableProps
types.doc: A table whose rows nest. Rows expand and collapse on a spring with indent guides, parents carry tri-state checkboxes, sorting reorders siblings without breaking the hierarchy, and children can load on first expand. The first column holds the tree. Keyboard follows the treegrid pattern: arrows move and expand, Space selects, Enter activates, * expands siblings.

members.name: selectable
members.doc: Adds a checkbox column. Checking a parent checks everything under it.

members.name: loadChildren
members.doc: Loads the children of a row with hasChildren the first time it expands. A rejected promise shows a retry row.

members.name: rowLabel
members.doc: Names a row for its checkbox, such as the file or team name.

members.name: onRowActivate
members.doc: Called when a row without children is clicked or gets Enter. Parent rows toggle instead.

members.name: maxHeight
members.doc: Caps the height; the header stays pinned while the body scrolls.
